verdict.rationale: Both diffs make the same correct change: a Map from normalized email to first index, built once and updated as contacts are appended, which preserves first-match and intra-upload merge behavior. A adds a regression test pinning the subtle first-match behavior when the stored book already has duplicate emails, which is exactly what this rewrite could have broken. A's report is also careful about what it did not verify. B claims the output is identical but lists only timing in its verification.
a_issues: The benchmark compared only output counts, not full output, though the report says so.
b_issues: No test added for the first-match behavior when stored entries share an email, which is the main risk of switching from findIndex to a Map.
The report says the output is identical, but the verification section describes only a timing run, so the equivalence claim appears unsupported.
